name: Step Four: Career
notes: Perhaps one of the most defining parts of the lifepath, this step determines your character's career: the path that they have chosen to follow. A character's career has a significant impact on them, narratively and mechanically, and these benefits are explained below.

options.name: Acolyte
options.description: Your character's career is in service to their faith or to a religious institution, whether that may be as a priest, a holy knight, or an ascetic monk.

grants.valuePrompt: Reflect why the character chose this career and what it means to them. Example: 'The Arysian Faith Is The Way Of Righteousness.'

options.name: Artisan
options.description: Your character's career is involved in the crafting of some kind of specialized good that they sell in a shop or take commissions from patrons. They might be a baker, leatherworker, potioneer, herbalist, etc.

grants.valuePrompt: Reflect why the character chose this career and what it means to them. Example: 'My Work Is My Life.'

options.name: Courtier
options.description: Your character has made a career out of being in a noble's court. Whether this is as a lady-in-waiting, an advisor, or maybe an artist or scholar under contract, the character spends most of their time in service to a member of the nobility.

grants.valuePrompt: Reflect why the character chose this career and what it means to them. Example: 'Forever Indebted To My Patron.'

options.name: Criminal
options.description: Your character is a criminal, and has made a career out of illegal trades like thievery or maybe even assassination.

grants.valuePrompt: Reflect why the character chose this career and what it means to them. Example: 'I Live By My Own Rules.'

options.name: Laborer
options.description: Your character's career is one of hard labor, whether that's working in agriculture as a laborer in the field, or as a house servant doing the menial tasks that keep a household running.

grants.valuePrompt: Reflect why the character chose this career and what it means to them. Example: 'A Society That Mistreats Its Laborers Is Unjust.'

options.name: Merchant
options.description: Your character's career has been made in finance, and in moving money and goods from place to place.

grants.valuePrompt: Reflect why the character chose this career and what it means to them. Example: 'Cultural Exchange Is Always Valuable.'

options.name: Outcast
options.description: One of the more varied careers, characters who are Outcasts are marked by their time spent outside of society on the fringes of civilization. They may work as a hedgemage or as a ranger.

grants.valuePrompt: Reflect why the character chose this career and what it means to them. Example: 'I Do My Best Work Alone.'

options.name: Ruler
options.description: Your character's career has been spent learning how to rule, and presiding over a town, city, or larger territory.

grants.valuePrompt: Reflect why the character chose this career and what it means to them. Example: 'The Crown Is A Heavy Burden.'

options.name: Soldier
options.description: Your character's career is on the battlefield, whether as a fighter, healer, or tactician. They may be in an army that fights for the sake of one kingdom or institution, or a mercenary whose loyalties are only to their pay.

grants.valuePrompt: Reflect why the character chose this career and what it means to them. Example: 'The Most Honorable Death is on the Battlefield.'

options.name: Scholar
options.description: Your character has pursued a career in study, dedicated to research and the pursuit of knowledge.

grants.valuePrompt: Reflect why the character chose this career and what it means to them. Example: 'There is Always an Answer to Every Question.'
